SELECT id, dept_code AS code, dept_name AS name, dept_type AS type FROM department WHERE active = TRUE AND dept_type = 'OUTPATIENT'
AND (dept_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR dept_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY dept_code

SELECT e.id, e.real_name AS name, e.department_id, e.regist_level_id AS registration_level_id, rl.regist_name AS registration_level_name, rl.regist_fee AS registration_fee FROM employee e JOIN department d ON d.id = e.department_id AND d.active = TRUE JOIN regist_level rl ON rl.id = e.regist_level_id AND rl.active = TRUE WHERE e.active = TRUE AND e.department_id = #{departmentId} AND e.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY e.real_name
SELECT id, regist_code AS code, regist_name AS name, regist_fee AS fee, regist_quota AS quota FROM regist_level WHERE active = TRUE ORDER BY sequence_no, id
SELECT id, settle_code AS code, settle_name AS name FROM settle_category WHERE active = TRUE ORDER BY sequence_no, id
